instruction: Open https://waterdata.usgs.gov/monitoring-location/USGS-01646500/. Select Daily data for water temperature in degrees Celsius from the active multiparameter sonde (not discontinued depth-specific sensors), for September 12-13, 2025. In Download data select Daily data - Mean and initiate its CSV request. A Maximum or Minimum request alone does not satisfy this task. The outcome is initiation of the correct data request; a saved ZIP is not required.
